provenance.howVerified: The sluz row was aligned against the Dan cikla row at three magnifications. As an independent check, classifying the Obcutek/Videz rows through the R-MUCUS-01 table reproduces all fourteen printed symbols.

expected.classification: Every day's `mucus` symbol above is the one the sheet prints. Deriving it from `sensation` and `appearance` through the R-MUCUS-01 table must reproduce all fourteen. Days 11, 13 and 14 are the discriminating ones: only the wet-sensation short-circuit yields S+ there.
expected.notes: The workbook's answer covers only the start of the cycle. It states two things: fertility runs from day 1 because this is a first observed cycle with no evaluated predecessor (R-FIRST-01's precondition), and day 5's temperature is bracketed (R-DIST-02). It draws no helper line, no triangles and no P/, so no temperature evaluation is asserted here. Day 5 is also the trap: at 37.05 it would wreck a helper line if the engine failed to exclude it.
